general_information.Description: The course provides students with continuous information and knowledge about financial appraisal of investment projects, how to manage the investment projects more effectively in order to survive competition and takeover in practical environment. Topics include: Capital budgeting; Project Cash flow and its forecasting; Essential formulae in Project appraisal; Project analysis under certainty; Project analysis under risk; Sensitivity and break-even analysis; Simulation concepts and methods; Financial modeling case study in forestry project evaluation
general_information.StudentTasks: - Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend more than 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (http://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand definition of capital structure, cost of capital and how optimize capital struture is formed up. Identify ways to calculate capital budeting through methods of accounting returns, payback period, NPV (net present value)
Understanding and applying quantitative forecasting techniques for a given project
Identify risks in finance and how these risks are managed in the context of financial stress and mismanagement
Able to explain and apply concept of "sensitivity analysis" and "break even analysis"
Able to deploy and apply simulation to the evaluation of project financial risks
Understand the purpose and Identify structure of linear programming models

assessments.Duration: Presentation in class and submit a report of at least 5 pages (end of the course)
assessments.Question Type: Suggestion: Lecturer chooses a published paper on specified topics (refer to Schedule), lets students prepare at home in groups and present in class
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Comprehensive reading, understanding issues, presenting problems, Personal qualities: Individual responsibility, self-esteem, sociability, self-management, and integrity.
assessments.Note: Group's mark considered as related individual's mark

assessments.Question Type: Suggestion: Students are required to prepare a project report, based on Financial Appraisal of investment project
